description: Return the closed-forecast record of a speaker or institution: counts of met, partial and not met, and a hit rate per register area. Hit rates count only forecasts whose criterion was fixed before the outcome; retrospective (back-captured) entries are counted separately under retrospective. Uses public and MCP-only entries, never internal ones. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.

institution.description: Name of the institution or organisation to match (case- and accent-insensitive, partial match allowed; common abbreviations understood, for example SNB, Fed/FOMC, ECB/EZB, IMF, TTWO, NVDA). Alias: organisation.

speaker.description: Name of the person or official speaker to match (case- and accent-insensitive; partial names, surnames and common short forms allowed, for example Altman or Powell).

name: track_record
